Give the order, Peazy.|[[Lieutenant]] [[Kaydel Ko Connix]] and [[PZ-4CO]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]]|''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''}} '''Bollie Prindel''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Urodel]] who served the [[Resistance]] during their [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Prindel was stationed as a [[Resistance ground crew|ground crew]] [[quartermaster]] in the Resistance's [[Resistance base|base of operations]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. The [[alien]] was present at the base during the preparation for the Resistance's [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]].{{Film|VII}} While on D'Qar, Prindel wore a [[Color|brown]] uniform including duty uniform trousers and also used a [[comlink]] headset and inventory [[datapad]]. Prindel had blue [[eye]]s and gray and pink skin. Prindel was later present on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the Resistance [[flagship]], the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], shortly before it was [[Battle of Oetchi|attacked]] and destroyed by the First Order. Later on, the crew of the ''Raddus'', including Prindel, witnessed [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]]'s introductory speech.{{Film|VIII}} ==Behind the scenes== Bollie Prindel first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]]. The character was not identified in the film, but received a name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film. He was portrayed by [[Ian Whyte]] with animatronic performance by Patrick Comerford. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Bollie Prindel}} *''[[Star Wars: Force Arena]]'' *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Age of Resistance - Rey 1|''Age of Resistance - Rey'' 1]] *{{Film|VIII}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' *{{RollOut|BB-8 and the Jungle Adventure - Chapter 1}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Bollie Prindel}} *{{SWYouTube|qV_dg8Citm4|The Creatures, Droids and Aliens of Star Wars: The Force Awakens | Star Wars Celebration Europe 2016}} *''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]'' {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|46|Helmets}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{Databank|amilyn-holdo|Amilyn Holdo}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|bollie-prindel|Bollie Prindel}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Bollie Prindel |de=Bollie Prindel#kanon |fr=Bollie Prindel |ja=ボリー・プリンデル |pl=Bollie Prindel |pt=Bollie Prindel }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Prindel, Bollie}} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Resistance members]] [[Category:Urodel]]
